# Case 31: Reliability and Factor Analysis

## Purpose

This report evaluates the reliability and factor structure of the multi-item scales used for Research Questions 3 and 6.

The analyses focus only on:

- R3: Q3–Q6, measuring employee proficiency
- R6: Q31–Q34, measuring operational effectiveness

These analyses determine whether the items can reasonably be combined into composite scales. They do not answer the substantive research questions.
